title: Late-Payment Interest Rate by Age of the Loss — Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)
content:
**Schedule of yearly interest rates.** The yearly interest rate on late-payment interest on an Excess Flood loss-of-use payment is 10 percent where the date of loss is 12 or more whole months before the payment and 9 percent where it is 6 to 11 whole months before. A date of loss fewer than 6 whole months before the payment is not on this schedule.

The date of loss is the one recorded at first notice of the claim; the payment date is the day the payment is issued.

| Whole months from the date of loss to the payment | Yearly interest rate |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 10 percent |
| 6 to 11 | 9 percent |
| fewer than 6 | not on this schedule |

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** For a payment issued on the 20th of a month: a date of loss on the 20th of the same month a year earlier is 12 whole months back (10 percent); on the 21st it is 11 whole months back (9 percent). Six months back, the 20th gives 6 whole months (9 percent) and the 21st gives 5 (not on this schedule).
